note: Grandparents' sitting room off the second dressing room. Feminine left (little girl with a fish fillet, niece with scraped knees, granny wrapping a boy like a mummy), the ancestor's portrait (ancêtre, either gender) high on the wall above the mantelpiece, masculine right: back row (father with pram and parrot, nephew refusing broccoli, twins with toy elephants, brother-in-law with a bow on his head in a friar's robe, hairy man with the Taj Mahal from the chest, descendant climbing down from the painted family tree, divorced couple with the sawn-in-two sofa), front row (stepfather with bow tie and pear, grandson in a fez, little heir with crown and furry tie, son-in-law with a gander, grandpa with a puppy, toddler with a drum, two half-brothers (one a mini friar, one in football kit), tall parents' boots beside baby booties for parental). Door back to the dressing room on the left; zoom on the mantelpiece photographs.
